title: Control the Water: Mexico deep edition

questions.q: In "Read your local market Understand", which of these is a key idea?
o: Channels: messaging apps, social media and marketplaces; local fairs and markets for a first test.
Dates: first test, first order, first review.
Keep a list of every tool that stores customer data, including messaging apps.
A large market with strong regional differences. Start in one city and one niche.

questions.q: In "Choose your sector Analyse", which of these is a key idea?
o: One measure per week: enquiries, orders or revenue; pick one.
Cluster A, Online selling and marketing: Strong fit: messaging-app selling and marketplaces. Offer cash-payment and bank-transfer options.
Local caution: A large country: start in one city, test one offer, then grow.
Language: Spanish first, in plain words; add English only if customers ask.

questions.q: In "Register and license Apply", which of these is a key idea?
o: Close to the northern trading partners: near-shoring creates demand for services, testing and training.
Issue electronic invoices as the tax rules require; learn the tool before the first customer. Check with a local expert.
Compute capacity and cost.
Keep a list of every tool that stores customer data, including messaging apps.

questions.q: In "Protect data and customers Apply", which of these is a key idea?
o: Staff may share in profits; small and new firms can differ, so read the rule before you hire. Check with a local expert.
Log rainfall, level and flow data with dates; keep records for audit.
Launch with one site and a go or no-go rule. Check with a local expert.
Add tax and duty explicitly; never bury them in a price. Check with a local expert.

questions.q: In "Find and serve customers Create", which of these is a key idea?
o: Register with the tax authority (a tax ID) before you invoice; choose sole trader or company. Check with a local expert.
Trust: tax ID, address, delivery days and a refund note on every page; consumer rules apply. Check with a local expert.
Partner with a technical college or business chamber to find helpers and to practise.
Check water rights, drainage, dam safety and environment rules before building. Check with a local expert.

questions.q: In "Price, tax and money Evaluate", which of these is a key idea?
o: Cluster H, People and business support: Coaching, coworking and outsourcing fit a young workforce; many founders need support in Spanish.
Contribution per unit = price minus the cost of each unit.
Launch with one site and a go or no-go rule. Check with a local expert.
A simplified small-taxpayer regime may fit a first year; read the current limits.

questions.q: In "People and partners Apply", which of these is a key idea?
o: Employers register staff for social security and pay the year-end bonus; budget both.
Check water rights, drainage, dam safety and environment rules before building. Check with a local expert.
Cluster F, Food and farming: Strong fit: food and farming are central; check health-risk rules for food and alternative proteins. Check with a local expert.
Many customers use bank transfers, cash-payment points and cards; a lot of buying is on messaging apps.

questions.q: In "Launch plan and review Create", which of these is a key idea?
o: Write MXN next to every number.
Channels: messaging apps, social media and marketplaces; local fairs and markets for a first test.
Keep a risk list with a response for each; include a rules change. Check with a local expert.
Issue electronic invoices as the tax rules require; learn the tool before the first customer. Check with a local expert.
